def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

    """The (top, bottom, left, right) bounding box of cells of the given color (the frame outline)."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i in range(H) if color in grid[i]]
    cols = [j for j in range(W) if any(grid[i][j] == color for i in range(H))]
    return min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)

def interior(grid, bounds=None):
    """The (i, j) cells strictly inside the frame bounds (default from frame_bounds)."""
    top, bot, left, right = bounds if bounds else frame_bounds(grid)
    return [(i, j) for i in range(top + 1, bot) for j in range(left + 1, right)]

def chebyshev(p, q):
    """The Chebyshev (chessboard) distance between two (row, col) points."""
    return max(abs(p[0] - q[0]), abs(p[1] - q[1]))

def distance_fill(grid, center, fill, keep=0, colors=None, region=None):
    """Recolor each cell of region (default: interior of frame_bounds) by its Chebyshev
    distance from center: distance <= keep keeps its current color, otherwise colors[dist] cyc."""
    colors = colors or [4, 2]
    cells = region if region is not None else interior(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for (i, j) in cells:
        dist = chebyshev((i, j), center)
        if dist > keep:
            out[i][j] = colors[(dist - keep - 1) % len(colors)]
    return out
'''
